pylon_fullstack.title: Pylon — Software Engineer (Full-Stack / B2B Support Platform)
pylon_fullstack.text:
Pylon — Software Engineer (Full-Stack / B2B Support Platform)
We are building the modern B2B customer support and account intelligence platform.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong experience with React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs.
- Experience with Golang (Go) and Rust for high-throughput backend services.
- Experience querying GraphQL APIs, caching with Redis, and deploying on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda).

Preferred Qualifications:
- Comfortable with Agile workflows and tracking issues in Jira.
- Familiarity with Docker, Tailwind CSS, and Webhooks.

backend_infra.title: Stripe — Backend Infrastructure Engineer
backend_infra.text:
Stripe — Backend Infrastructure Engineer
Join our core API and payments reliability engineering organization.

Required Qualifications:
- Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or Java for distributed backend systems.
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, and Docker.
- Experience deploying services on AWS and building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Kubernetes, Ruby on Rails, and Linear for sprint tracking.
- Strong end-to-end ownership of REST APIs and Webhooks.

ml_platform.title: Scale AI — Machine Learning Platform Engineer
ml_platform.text:
Scale AI — Machine Learning Platform Engineer
We build infrastructure for computer vision, LLMs, and multimodal evaluation.

Qualifications:
- Strong programming skills in Python, PyTorch, and FastAPI.
- Experience containerizing workloads with Docker and deploying on AWS.
- Familiarity with Redis caching, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.

Bonus Points:
- Experience with CUDA, Scala, and Agile sprints in Jira.

frontend_product.title: Vercel — Product Engineer (Frontend & Design Systems)
frontend_product.text:
Vercel — Product Engineer (Frontend & Design Systems)
Build high-Craft developer experiences on the web.

What You'll Need:
- Deep expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- Experience consuming REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints.
- Familiarity with Node.js, Vercel, and Git workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Swift or Kotlin mobile clients.
- Comfortable working in Linear and shipping end-to-end features.
